About the Project

The Designing Responsible Natural Language Processing CDT combines language technology with responsible design and interdisciplinary research. Its application process begins with a first-stage online form.

Research Areas

  • Natural language processing
  • responsible AI and interdisciplinary research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
FundingFull tuition and research/travel funding under the selected studentship terms.
MaintenanceLiving stipend; confirm the applicable funding route
Duration4 years

Eligibility and Requirements

Relevant academic preparation and research alignment with responsible natural language processing; check fee-status conditions for each funding route. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
RecruitmentSeptember 2027 applications open
DeadlineStage 1: 30 November 2026, midnight UK; invited Stage 2: 22 January 2027

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://app.onlinesurveys.jisc.ac.uk/s/edinburgh/drnlp-cdt-2026

Source: app.onlinesurveys.jisc.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Complete the Stage 1 online form in your own words, including research experience and alignment. No attachments are accepted at Stage 1; Stage 2 is by invitation.

This interdisciplinary CDT brings together language technology and questions about responsible design and use.

About the University of Edinburgh

The University of Edinburgh offers doctoral research across science, engineering, humanities, social sciences and health. Its research schools host scholarship competitions and doctoral training programmes with different admission and funding routes.
